answer: Charge newcomers a bond posted by an established sponsor, refunded only after their first graded work clears review by unrelated peers. One fake account is cheap; ten thousand fakes need ten thousand solvent sponsors, and the cost curve stops being flat. Think of each verified member as an island joined to the mainland by a bridge someone else paid for. A ring that vouches only inside itself spirals inward: no outside traffic, no graded output, and the whole hollow cluster gets slashed at once.
